verdict.rationale: SolidJS is an open-source client/server UI rendering library with no hosted service, account system, or API of its own, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any credential or API-key capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
